chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 time, a slow rocking rowing pulse like oars on a long swell
a lone soft pulse-wave lead playing a slow seafaring hymn tune with space between phrases
a gently rocking plucked bass like oar strokes
one soft glass bell blinking every two bars like a far lighthouse
a very soft sampled string pad
lonely, wide open sea at dusk in the fog, steady and hopeful
seamless transition back to the theme
